releases.name: Tivano 1.0.2
releases.body:
[Download Tivano (.dmg, Apple silicon)](https://github.com/elijah7x/tivano/releases/download/v1.0.2/Tivano-1.0.2.dmg)

Open the DMG and drag Tivano to Applications. The Source code archives below are for developers, not app installers.

## Refinements

- Fill the update progress bar with the current theme's accent instead of a fixed blue.

## Thanks

- No outside contributors.
